$comment: Models the conversation lab (docs/runbooks/conversation-lab.md) calls itself, besides the app's own models from infra/cdk/config/production.json. Each list is tried in order; the first model that answers a one-token probe is used, and the run prints which. The FoundryAscent-ConversationLab role (infra/cdk/src/stacks/foundation-stack.ts) may invoke exactly these ids and the app's. Prices: Amazon Bedrock on-demand, us-east-1, USD per million tokens (checked 2026-10-17); the lab meters its own calls with them. The live suite (conversation_lab/live) uses its own lists under "live": a simulator and a judge from model families other than the app's (Amazon Nova), falling back to Nova when the account has not enabled them; the run reports which family played and judged. Their prices are the higher of the published on-demand figures checked 2026-11-05 (verify on the Bedrock pricing page): metering high keeps the hard caps safe.
